decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter applies the firm's existing curing, seasoning and slicing know-how to its strategic organic expansion, so management can read its early retail results and refine it, though it only gets a brief website mention.

The organic poultry mini salami snack builds directly on the firm's maturation and seasoning expertise, fits the stated push into organic lines and new formats, and has its own website page, which signals commitment and a basis for learning-driven improvement.
The premium sharing salami snack is a close extension of the core salami competence with its own website page, so the firm can absorb market feedback and adjust it rather than drop it after one year.
